name: Rasa Juknevičienė - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament says Georgia's government has turned away from democracy and the European Union since the disputed October 2024 election. It asks the European Union to stop treating Georgia's leaders as legitimate, to impose sanctions on those responsible, to keep supporting Georgian citizens, civil society and independent media, and to back new free elections. The report is the Parliament's opinion and request; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks the European Union to act.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's government, officials, protesters, journalists and civil society.
- **What happens next:** European Union governments decide on sanctions and on recognising Georgia's leaders.
